title: Connected Burn CPU/WASM adapter-only global step

training_method.label: Frozen-base LoRA
training_method.description: Differentiate and return only the eight rank-4 fused-QKV adapter tensors while executing the complete frozen T0 base.

execution_topology.label: Connected two-browser global step
execution_topology.description: Two authenticated browser workers lease disjoint two-row assignments; the coordinator accepts each once, sums FP32 adapter gradients, normalizes and clips once, applies AdamW, and owns the canonical adapter checkpoint.

memory_profiles.label: Browser CPU-resident
memory_profiles.description: The complete T0 frozen base and small adapter reside in browser-addressable WASM memory.

numerical_profiles.label: Burn NdArray FP32 LoRA
numerical_profiles.description: Burn 0.21 Autodiff over NdArray f32 tensors with coordinator FP32 aggregation and canonical AdamW.

worker_profiles.label: Two logical Headless Chrome 150 Windows CPU workers
worker_profiles.description: Two owner-approved worker identities executed sequentially in the same local headless Chrome environment through the CPU/WASM backend.

limits.label: Maximum elapsed browser time per pass

reproduction.notes: At cab9b6c49e4b9fad666a9f42396a28541ffc84ce, build the browser worker with ORCACOLONY_LORA_CONFIG=campaign/t0-lora-smoke.json, start from a fresh state directory, and open the documented browser-a and browser-b CPU/WASM worker URLs.
